title: Something went wrong
validation_failed: Some fields are not valid: check them and try again.
weak_password: The password is too weak: use at least 12 uncommon characters.
invalid_reset_token: The link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
invalid_totp: The code is wrong or has expired.
pairing_code_invalid: The pairing code is invalid or has expired.
invalid_scope: One or more of the selected permissions are not allowed.
invalid_webhook_url: The webhook URL is invalid or cannot be reached safely.
unknown_event_type: One or more event types do not exist.
unauthorized: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
totp_required: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
csrf_failed: Your session is no longer valid. Reload the page and try again.
totp_enrolment_required: You must enable two-step verification to continue.
totp_required_by_policy: Two-step verification is mandatory for your role.
conflict: The operation conflicts with the current state.
slug_taken: This identifier is already in use.
already_member: This person is already in the team.
last_owner: At least one owner must remain.
totp_not_enrolled: Start the two-step verification setup first.
idempotency_in_progress: An identical request is still running. Wait a moment.
version_conflict: Someone else changed this data. Reload to see the latest version.
rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again shortly.
not_ready: The service is not ready yet. Try again shortly.
map_invalid: The map breaks validation rules: fix the reported errors.
map_not_empty: The map still has berths, areas or land resources.
invalid_file: Invalid file, or it does not match the declared type.
file_too_large: The file is larger than the 15 MB limit.
csv_invalid: The CSV file is not valid.
customer_anonymized: The customer has been anonymised and cannot be changed.
customer_merged: The customer was merged into another one and cannot be changed.
download_link_expired: The download link has expired or is not valid. Request a new one.
no_price: No price for this request: check the price list, period and category.
promo_not_applicable: The promo code does not apply to this request.
price_list_invalid: The price list has blocking errors: fix them before activating it.
price_list_immutable: The price list is already published and cannot change: create a copy or a renewal.
price_list_overlap: Another active price list covers the same days for the same contract type.
in_use: This is still in use and cannot be deleted: deactivate it instead.
resource_taken: The place is already occupied on some nights of the requested period.
fit_blocked: The vessel does not fit the chosen place.
invalid_transition: This action is not allowed in the current state.
hold_expired: The hold on the place has expired.
closure_active: Arrivals are closed on that date.
undo_unavailable: The move can no longer be undone.
customer_required: A customer is required to confirm.
renewal_exists: The contract already has an open renewal proposal.
proposal_closed: The renewal proposal is no longer open.
signature_open: A signature request is already open.
otp_locked: Too many wrong codes: request a new code.
otp_rate_limited: Too many codes requested: try again in a few minutes.
link_invalid: The link is not valid or has expired.
template_limits: The template exceeds the size limits.
paper_scan_required: Upload the scan of the signed document.
insurance_required: The vessel has no valid insurance.
customer_email_missing: The customer has no email address.
shares_invalid: Holder shares must sum to 1000 thousandths.
table_incomplete: The millesimal table must sum to 1000.
table_active: An active table cannot be changed.
transfer_requirements: The transfer requirements are not met.
mandate_overlap: Another mandate covers the same nights.
vessel_in_other_fleet: The vessel is already in another active fleet.
vessel_not_in_fleet: The vessel is not in the fleet.
import_not_undoable: The import can no longer be undone.
charge_immutable: An exported, invoiced, paid or offset charge cannot change: use an adjustment.
use_edit: The charge can still be edited directly.
match_exceeds: The match exceeds the payment amount or the charge residual.
refund_exceeds: The refund exceeds the unallocated amount of the payment.
credit_insufficient: The customer's credit is not enough.
not_deposit: The payment is not a deposit.
no_termination_amount: The contract has no termination amount.
not_exported: The charge has not been exported yet.
export_empty: No charges to export in the period.
export_too_large: Too many charges for one export: shorten the period.
cash_session_open: The register already has an open session.
cash_insufficient: There is not enough cash in the register.
provider_refund_unsupported: The provider cannot refund this payment.
provider_error: The payment provider returned an error.
billing_item_missing: The billing item for this entry is missing in the settings.
first_run_token_invalid: The first-run link is invalid or already used: restart the app.
first_run_done: The first run is already completed: log in with your account.
lan_port_unavailable: The local network port is already used by another program: choose another one.
lan_no_address: This computer has no local network address: connect it to the office Wi-Fi or network.
backup_in_progress: A backup or restore is already running: wait for it to finish.
restore_failed: The backup cannot be restored: the current data was not changed.
restore_backup_newer: The backup was made by a newer version of Porto: update the app and try again. The current data was not changed.
allocation_changed: The vessel's berth changed after the operation was queued: check the new berth and try again.
offline_not_allowed: This operation cannot be recorded offline: repeat it when you are connected.
remote_unreachable: The online Porto cannot be reached: check the connection. Allowed operations stay queued.
remote_pin_mismatch: The online Porto presented a certificate different from the expected one: connection stopped for safety.
peripheral_unavailable: The peripheral is not configured or not ready.
claim_expired: The claim of the fiscal document expired: it will be retried.
invalid_period: Invalid period: the end date must follow the start date and the period cannot exceed 400 days.
invalid_report_filter: One of the report filters is not valid.
report_too_large: Too many rows for one export: shorten the period or add filters.
booking_unavailable: No berth of this category is available any more: choose another category or other dates.
booking_rules: The dates or the boat do not meet the marina's online booking rules.
booking_busy: Too many bookings in progress: please retry in a moment.
consent_required: You must accept the terms and the privacy notice to continue.
text_outdated: The terms have been updated: read and accept them again.
refund_changed: The refund changed since the preview: check the new amount.
price_changed: The price changed since the preview: check the new amount.
cancellation_not_allowed: This booking cannot be cancelled online: contact the marina.
idempotency_mismatch: The request was already sent with different data: reload the page and retry.
storage_target_invalid: Storage needs a surface area of a yard or shed, or a trailer spot.
storage_no_space: No free position in the area for the period: open a scenario to rearrange it.
area_exits_invalid: An exit of the area is not usable or not on the border: fix the map.
pinned_invalid: A pinned boat is not valid in its position.
too_many_items: Too many boats for one optimization.
scenario_not_draft: The scenario is no longer a draft.
scenario_conflicts: The scenario conflicts with the current state: nothing was applied.
movement_not_pending: The movement is no longer pending.
maintenance_conflicts: Boats occupy the element on the maintenance nights: move them and retry.
reading_charged: The reading is used by a charged consumption.
consumption_frozen: The consumption is already charged or excluded.
